files.dbt_project.yml:
# Name your project! Project names should contain only lowercase characters
# and underscores. A good package name should reflect your organization's
# name or the intended use of these models
name: 'jaffle_dbt'
version: '1.0.0'

# This setting configures which "profile" dbt uses for this project.
profile: 'jaffle_dbt'

# These configurations specify where dbt should look for different types of files.
# The `model-paths` config, for example, states that models in this project can be
# found in the "models/" directory. You probably won't need to change these!
model-paths: ["models"]
analysis-paths: ["analyses"]
test-paths: ["tests"]
seed-paths: ["seeds"]
macro-paths: ["macros"]
snapshot-paths: ["snapshots"]

clean-targets:         # directories to be removed by `dbt clean`
  - "target"
  - "dbt_packages"


# Configuring models
# Full documentation: https://docs.getdbt.com/docs/configuring-models

models:
  jaffle_dbt:
    staging:
      +materialized: view
    intermediate:
      +materialized: view
    marts:
      +materialized: table
files.models/intermediate/int_payments__succes:
{{ config(materialized='ephemeral') }}

with

payments as (

    select * from {{ ref('stg_stripe__payments') }}

),

successful as (

    select
        payment_id,
        order_id,
        payment_method,
        amount,
        created_at

    from payments
    where status = 'success'

)

select * from successful
files.models/marts/dim_customers.sql:
with

customers as (

    select * from {{ ref('stg_jaffle_shop__customers') }}

),

orders as (

    select * from {{ ref('fct_orders') }}

),

customer_orders as (

    select
        customer_id,
        min(order_date) as first_order_date,
        max(order_date) as most_recent_order_date,
        count(order_id) as number_of_orders,
        sum(amount) as lifetime_value

    from orders
    group by customer_id

),

final as (

    select
        customers.customer_id,
        customers.first_name,
        customers.last_name,
        customers.email,
        customers.country,
        customer_orders.first_order_date,
        customer_orders.most_recent_order_date,
        coalesce(customer_orders.number_of_orders, 0) as number_of_orders,
        coalesce(customer_orders.lifetime_value, 0) as lifetime_value

    from customers
    left join customer_orders
        on customers.customer_id = customer_orders.customer_id

)

select * from final
files.models/marts/fct_orders.sql:
with

orders as (

    select * from {{ ref('stg_jaffle_shop__orders') }}

),

payments as (

    select * from {{ ref('int_payments__successful') }}

),

order_payments as (

    select
        order_id,
        sum(amount) as amount

    from payments
    group by order_id

),

final as (

    select
        orders.order_id,
        orders.customer_id,
        orders.order_date,
        orders.status,
        coalesce(order_payments.amount, 0) as amount

    from orders
    left join order_payments
        on orders.order_id = order_payments.order_id

)

select * from final
files.models/staging/jaffle_shop/_jaffle_shop_:
version: 2

models:
  - name: stg_jaffle_shop__customers
    description: One row per customer, cleaned (email in lower case).
    columns:
      - name: customer_id
        description: Primary key of the customer.
        data_tests:
          - unique
          - not_null
      - name: email
        description: Email address in lower case. NULL when the customer gave none.

  - name: stg_jaffle_shop__orders
    description: One row per order.
    columns:
      - name: order_id
        description: Primary key of the order.
        data_tests:
          - unique
          - not_null
      - name: customer_id
        description: The customer who placed the order.
      - name: status
        description: Order status (placed, shipped, completed, return_pending, returned).
      - name: loaded_at
        description: When the row was loaded into the warehouse.

  - name: stg_jaffle_shop__order_items
    description: One row per product line inside an order.
    columns:
      - name: order_item_id
        description: Primary key of the order item.
        data_tests:
          - unique
          - not_null

  - name: stg_jaffle_shop__products
    description: One row per product, price in dollars.
    columns:
      - name: product_id
        description: Primary key of the product.
        data_tests:
          - unique
          - not_null
      - name: price
        description: Unit price in dollars.

version: 2

sources:
  - name: jaffle_shop
    description: Raw data copied every night from the Jaffle Shop web application.
    schema: jaffle_shop   # same as the source name, so this line is optional
    tables:
      - name: customers
        description: One row per customer account.
      - name: orders
        description: One row per order. user_id points to customers.id.
      - name: order_items
        description: One row per product line inside an order.
      - name: products
        description: The product catalogue. Prices are in cents.
files.models/staging/jaffle_shop/stg_jaffle_sh:
with

source as (

    select * from {{ source('jaffle_shop', 'customers') }}

),

renamed as (

    select
        id as customer_id,
        first_name,
        last_name,
        lower(email) as email,
        country,
        signup_date

    from source

)

select * from renamed

with

source as (

    select * from {{ source('jaffle_shop', 'order_items') }}

),

renamed as (

    select
        id as order_item_id,
        order_id,
        product_id,
        quantity

    from source

)

select * from renamed

with

source as (

    select * from {{ source('jaffle_shop', 'orders') }}

),

renamed as (

    select
        id as order_id,
        user_id as customer_id,
        order_date,
        status,
        _loaded_at as loaded_at

    from source

)

select * from renamed

with

source as (

    select * from {{ source('jaffle_shop', 'products') }}

),

renamed as (

    select
        id as product_id,
        name as product_name,
        category,
        -- cents -> dollars, stored as an exact decimal (not a float)
        cast(price_cents / 100 as decimal(16, 2)) as price

    from source

)

select * from renamed

models:
  - name: stg_stripe__payments
    description: One row per payment attempt, amount in dollars.
    columns:
      - name: payment_id
        description: Primary key of the payment.
        data_tests:
          - unique
          - not_null
      - name: status
        description: success or fail. Only successful payments count as revenue.
      - name: amount

files.models/staging/stripe/stg_stripe__paymen:
with

source as (

    select * from {{ source('stripe', 'payments') }}

),

renamed as (

    select
        id as payment_id,
        orderid as order_id,
        paymentmethod as payment_method,
        status,
        -- cents -> dollars, stored as an exact decimal (not a float)
        cast(amount / 100 as decimal(16, 2)) as amount,
        created as created_at,
        _loaded_at as loaded_at

    from source

)

select * from renamed
